info.name: Livestock ERP Financial Staff Advances API
info.description: Separate Postman collection for staff advance loans and repayments. Uses the single-entry cash in/out ledger. A confirmed loan posts cash out; a confirmed repayment posts cash in. Requires an active employed staff member, an active branch cashbook, an active cash-out category for loans, and an active cash-in category for repayments. Before reversals, configure each category's active opposite-direction reversal category using the Cash Ledger Categories API. All endpoints use /api/v1. Set IDs from your environment or run the related setup collections first. A staff member's advances use one currency; repayments must use that currency.

request.description: Choose an active, employed staff record and set staff_id. Staff Master must exist first.

response.name: List active staff

request.description: Choose an active cashbook in the staff member's branch and set cashbook_id. The same currency must be used for this staff member's later advances and repayments.
